title: State-of-the-Art Arabic Language Modeling with Sparse MoE Fine-Tuning and Chain-of-Thought Distillation
reasoning: The paper integrates 'regional ethical norms' and Islamic concepts like 'amanah' (trust) and 'sila' (kinship) directly into its Chain-of-Thought distillation process. It also evaluates performance on cultural and ethical alignment using the AraTrust benchmark and includes religious materials in its training corpus.
